desc: Prove the finite-field power-sum condition and the common factor \((-1)^K\), including variables unused by a walk.
Derive and validate the surviving walk classification for odd \(p>3\), showing repeated replaceable transitions must be diagonal and yielding \(C=DA+AD\).
Derive the additional \(p=3\) off-diagonal pattern \(u\to v\to u\to v\), including its exact contribution and avoiding double counting.
Handle \(p=2\) directly by replacing every zero with \(1\) and computing its square modulo \(2\).
Implement modular matrix exponentiation and the correction matrices in \(O(N^3\log p)\), with correct treatment of \(K\), signs, and all matrix entries.
Conceptually verify the formulas against all provided samples and edge cases such as no zeros, all zeros, \(N=1\), and \(p=3\).
